title: MP length expression
description: Essential Criteria: The response must give the final answer for part (1) as L = v₀/(kB).

title: Maximum velocity expression
description: Essential Criteria: The response must give the final answer for part (2) as v_max = v₀/3.

title: Radius from magnetic force
description: Important Criteria: Applies Newton's second law (qvB = mv²/R) to relate velocity, B, k, and trajectory radius.

title: Geometry for PQ exit
description: Important Criteria: For part (1), correctly constructs the geometric relationship (L sin α = R₁ - R₁ sin α) for the ion exiting PQ at maximum distance.

title: Geometry for MP exit
description: Important Criteria: For part (2), correctly constructs the geometric relationship (L = R₂/sin α + R₂) for the ion exiting MP with maximum velocity.

title: Algebraic solution
description: Optional Criteria: Shows clear algebraic steps to solve the geometric and physical equations for L and v_max.

title: Sign or charge confusion
description: Pitfall Criteria: Incorrectly uses the sign of the charge to determine the direction of circular motion, affecting the geometry.

title: Unit or ratio omission
description: Pitfall Criteria: Fails to include the charge-to-mass ratio k or the magnetic field B in the final expressions where required.
